series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

ndc_assessment.vintage: First (I)NDC round, as assessed by WRI CAIT (2016). Not the latest submission.
ndc_assessment.summary: "Barbados intends to achieve an economy-wide reduction in GHG emissions of 44% compared to its business as usual (BAU) scenario by 2030. In absolute terms, this translates to a reduction of 23% compared with the baseline year, 2008. As an interim target, the intention will be to achieve an economy-wide reduction of 37% compared to its business as usual (BAU) scenario by 2025, equivalent to an absolute reduction of 21% compared to 2008." The INDC also includes a section on adaptation.
ndc_assessment.ghg_target: 44% reduction by 2030 in GHG emissions compared to the BAU scenario, translating to a 23% reduction compared to 2008 in absolute terms; Interim target of 37% reduction compared to its BAU scenario by 2025
ndc_assessment.sectors: Energy (including domestic transport); Industrial Process and Product Use; Waste; Agriculture; Land Use, Land Use Change and Forestry
ndc_assessment.$note: Third-party assessment of the first (I)NDC round. It is not merged into ndc.*, is not used by derive(), and does not appear on the dial as a target.

ndc_document.$reason: the document states targets on more than one basis or horizon (base-year · 2008 · 2030; bau ·  · 2025; bau ·  · 2030); choosing between them would be a guess.

DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is 2025 Second Nationally Determined Contribution, filed 2025-08-30. 60 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (14). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 2.7 MtCO₂e, DS-35 1.5 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. ND-GAIN scores it 58.6 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 44% reduction by 2030 in GHG emissions compared to the BAU scenario, translating to a 23% reduction compared to 2008 in absolute terms; Interim target of 37% reduction compared to its BAU scenario by 2025 It was classed conditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +0.87°C under SSP1-2.6 to +2.92°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
